In NSW: Steelpipes, Piling Solutions Australia, Rigby Jones, Rollco, Metal Shop Technics, Southern Sheet & Coil, Coil Processors. In QLD: RPG Australia. MAIN OBJECTIVE
Responsible for managing engineering and production processes of jobs from quoting stage to completion, including planning, scheduling, NC programming, purchasing, follow up, liaising with customers, suppliers and coordinating with other team members during entire production process.

Sound knowledge, understanding and interpretation of engineering drawings

Meticulous — eye for detail

About us
We are a boutique education and migration services organisation with more than twenty (20) years of industry experience. We work closely with clients, institutions, host families, service providers, and corporate partners to support a diverse range of client needs. Our work sits at the intersection of education, migration compliance, and tailored support for international students and migrants who are new to Australia. We partner with stakeholders across multiple sectors to deliver responsive, compliant, and high quality services.

About the role
We are seeking a Corporate Engagement & Contracts Administrator to manage relationships, contracts, and service levels across our stakeholder network. This role is responsible for facilitating and administering end-to-end contract and partnership processes, from stakeholder engagement and onboarding through to implementation, monitoring, review, renewal, and compliance with contractual obligations. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys stakeholder engagement, detailed documentation, and ensuring that agreements are robust, compliant, and commercially sound.

Key responsibilities
•	Develop and maintain strong relationships with internal team members and external stakeholders, including employers, institutions, host families, and corporate sponsors.
•	Coordinate corporate and partnership onboarding, including explaining program requirements, contractual obligations, sponsorship expectations, and related responsibilities.
•	Prepare, review, administer, and manage contracts and related documentation, including agreements, MOUs, service contracts, renewals, and variations.
•	Develop and maintain an accurate contracts register and ensure all agreements are executed, stored securely, tracked, and renewed on time.
•	Monitor contract performance, service levels, and compliance obligations, escalating risks, inconsistencies, and issues where necessary.
•	Work closely with relevant internal and external stakeholders to ensure contract terms align with legal, regulatory, migration, and operational requirements.
•	Assist in managing corporate sponsor and host employer relationships to support clients requiring work sponsorship arrangements and related placement pathways.
•	Support reporting on contract outcomes, including placements, renewals, utilisation of sponsorship capacity, compliance matters, and stakeholder satisfaction.
•	Contribute to the continuous improvement of templates, workflows, registers, and standard operating procedures relating to contract management and corporate engagement processes.
Skills and experience
•	Demonstrated experience in contract administration, corporate client engagement, stakeholder relations, or a related administrative/compliance role.
•	At least 3 years of work experience in the education and visa sector is an added advantage.
•	Strong attention to detail and the ability to interpret agreements, policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
•	Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build rapport with a wide range of stakeholders.
•	Strong organisational skills, including the ability to manage multiple contracts, deadlines, competing priorities, and follow-up actions.
•	Confidence using document management systems, CRM platforms, contract registers, and related administrative systems.
•	A robust understanding of the Australian education and visa industry is highly desirable.
•	Experience working with employers, sponsors, international students, or migration-related stakeholders will be highly regarded.

Qualifications
•	Tertiary qualification in business, law, commerce, management, or a related field is desirable, or equivalent relevant experience in a contract-focused or client-facing role.
•	Ability to speak, read, and write more than one language is desirable.

Why join us?
•	Work closely with employers, sponsors, and clients on meaningful education, migration, and employment pathways.
•	Be part of a small, professional team with clear processes and a strong compliance culture.
•	Opportunity to grow into more senior contract management, corporate engagement, or operations responsibilities.

How to apply

Please submit your CV and a brief cover letter outlining your experience in contract administration, corporate engagement, and stakeholder management, and why you are interested in this role.

 SALARY RANGE -  $75K to $80K

Happy Travels is Australia’s leading backpacker travel agency, built on a passion for adventure and a commitment to creating unforgettable experiences. Despite the challenges faced by the travel industry in recent years, we’ve continued to grow by staying focused on what matters most - our people and our travellers.

We’re more than just a booking service. We’re a tight-knit, energetic team dedicated to helping backpackers and tourists make the most of their time in Australia, Fiji, and New Zealand. From once-in-a-lifetime tours to hidden local gems, we connect travellers with experiences that turn trips into lifelong memories.

At Happy Travels, it’s all about people, connection, and adventure.

Role Overview:

As a Travel Agency Manager, your primary focus will be to oversee the operations of our travel agency, ensuring exceptional service delivery and maximising sales performance. You will lead a team of Travel Sales Consultants, motivating and guiding them to achieve sales targets and provide outstanding customer experiences. A crucial part of your role will be the recruitment, training, and development of staff, ensuring they are equipped with the skills and knowledge to excel in their roles.

Key Responsibilities:
- Leading and overseeing the overall operations and strategic direction of the travel agency.
- Developing and implementing business plans and strategies to achieve company objectives and targets.
- Managing financial aspects, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance analysis.
- Building and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders, such as travel suppliers, partners, and clients.
- Analysing market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities and threats in the industry.
- Recruiting, training, and mentoring staff members to ensure a high level of professionalism and service quality.
- Setting performance goals and KPIs for the team, monitoring progress, and providing guidance as needed.
- Driving sales and revenue growth through effective marketing, pricing strategies, and product offerings.
- Developing and maintaining operational policies, procedures, and standards to ensure efficiency and compliance.
- Handling escalated customer issues and complaints, seeking resolution, and maintaining customer satisfaction.
- Negotiating contracts and agreements with suppliers to secure favourable terms and conditions.
- Staying updated on industry regulations, compliance requirements, and best practices.
- Utilising technology tools and systems to streamline operations and enhance customer experience.
- Analysing data and metrics to evaluate performance, identify areas for improvement, and make informed decisions.
- Representing the company at industry events, conferences, and trade shows to network and promote services.
- Monitoring and managing risk factors, such as safety, security, and legal liabilities, to protect the company’s interests.
- Fostering a positive work culture and environment that encourages teamwork, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary with performance-based incentives and superannuation package.
- Opportunities for career advancement and professional development.
- Travel incentives and familiarisation trips.
- Exclusive discounts on transport and accommodation.
- A supportive and dynamic work environment.

Qualifications:
- 3+ years experience as a travel agency manager or Diploma or Higher plus 1 year of experience.
- Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and inspire a team.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- A passion for travel and a commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences.
- Experience in staff recruitment, training, and development.
- Multilingual skills are a significant advantage.

Australian Citizens & Permanent Residents are encouraged to apply.

Join the Happy Travels team and lead the way in creating unforgettable experiences for travellers and adventurers. Apply now to become our Travel Agency Manager and embark on a rewarding career journey!
